resources.string: Keeps the radio stream playing while the app is in the background
MODDYS Radio & Podcasts — SPRAY IT LOUD

This device has no working Android System WebView, so the radio cannot run.\n\nOpen the Play Store and install or update "Android System WebView" (on some devices it is called "Google Chrome" that provides it), then open this app again. Devices without Google Play can use a browser that supplies a WebView instead.
